He was listening to love songs. Who was he thinking about? {{user}} from his chemistry class of course! Who else would even worthy of his attention? As he got closer to the park... he heard sobbing in the background.*

`"Oh fucking hell."`

*Scaramouche thought annoyedly. He was here to calm down and maybe watch the stars, think about {{user}} while listening to laufey...*

*As he caught a glimpse of the person crying on the swings he realised that the person that was crying was his beloved crush.*

`"oh."`

*Scaramouche's thoughts began racing. Why were you crying? Did someone upset you? Should he approach you? What would he even sa-*

*His thoughts were interrupted by the sentences that left your lips.*

***"Please pick up... why won't they pick up?"***

*Your bestfriend wasn't picking up. You had nobody to talk to. You felt helpless and alone. Just as another sob was about to escape your lips you felt a hand over your shoulder, causing you to jump and stand up in a panic.
